import sys, os, json, hashlib, importlib, tempfile, signal
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import UTC, datetime

def require(condition, code):
    if not condition:
        raise CheckFailure(code)

class CheckFailure(Exception):
    pass

loader_metadata_calls = []
def deny_external(event, args):
    if event == "subprocess.Popen":
        # CPython ctypes.util.find_library reads the Linux linker cache.
        # Permit only that bounded metadata command, never a service/worker.
        executable, argv, cwd, environment = args
        if CHECK == "ingestor" and executable == "/sbin/ldconfig" and argv == ["/sbin/ldconfig", "-p"] and cwd is None and not loader_metadata_calls:
            loader_metadata_calls.append("/sbin/ldconfig -p")
            return
        raise CheckFailure("external_operation_attempted:" + event)
    if event in {"socket.connect", "socket.connect_ex", "socket.bind", "socket.getaddrinfo", "socket.sendto", "os.system", "os.posix_spawn", "os.posix_spawnp"} or event.startswith("os.exec"):
        raise CheckFailure("external_operation_attempted:" + event)

sys.addaudithook(deny_external)
def deadline(signum, frame):
    raise CheckFailure("internal_20_second_deadline")
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, deadline)
signal.alarm(20)
report = {"schema": "verdify.candidate-image-packaging-check/v1", "status": "FAILED", "check": CHECK, "expected_source_revision": SOURCE, "runtime_uid": os.getuid(), "runtime_gid": os.getgid(), "image_default_uid": DEFAULT_UID, "scope": "secretless_image_packaging_only", "started_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), "physical_qualification": False, "actual_role_login_qualification": False, "deployment_qualification": False}
stage = "empty_cwd_and_image_source"
try:
    require(os.environ.get("VERDIFY_GIT_SHA") == SOURCE, "image_git_sha_mismatch")
    require(os.environ.get("PYTHONPATH") == "/app", "unexpected_pythonpath")
    require(not any(p == "" or (p and not (p == "/app" or p.startswith("/usr/local/lib/"))) for p in sys.path), "unexpected_import_search_path")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="verdify-image-only-", dir="/tmp") as isolated:
        os.chdir(isolated)
        require(not list(Path.cwd().iterdir()), "working_directory_not_empty")
        report["empty_working_directory"] = isolated
        actual = []
        for entry in FILES:
            path = Path(entry["image_path"])
            require(path.resolve() == path and path.is_file(), "image_path_missing_or_symlink:" + entry["image_path"])
            data = path.read_bytes()
            digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
            require(digest == entry["sha256"], "image_file_hash_mismatch:" + entry["image_path"])
            actual.append({**entry, "bytes": len(data)})
        report["verified_file_count"] = len(actual)
        report["verified_files"] = actual
        report["expected_manifest_sha256"] = MANIFEST_SHA
        origins = {}
        def checked_import(name, expected):
            module = importlib.import_module(name)
            path = Path(module.__file__).resolve()
            require(str(path) == expected, "unexpected_module_origin:" + name)
            origins[name] = str(path)
            return module
        stage = "orchestrator_imports_and_freezer_contract"
        db = checked_import("experiment_orchestrator.database", "/app/experiment_orchestrator/database.py")
        contracts = checked_import("experiment_orchestrator.contracts", "/app/experiment_orchestrator/contracts.py")
        actual_freezer = db.ROLE_FUNCTIONS[contracts.OrchestratorMode.FREEZER]
        require(actual_freezer == EXPECTED_FREEZER, "freezer_six_function_contract_mismatch")
        report["freezer_function_count"] = len(actual_freezer)
        report["freezer_functions"] = list(actual_freezer)
        stage = "readiness_imports_and_typed_hold"
        collector = checked_import("scripts.experiment_v2_proof_packet", "/app/scripts/experiment_v2_proof_packet.py")
        guard = checked_import("scripts.experiment_v2_readiness_guard", "/app/scripts/experiment_v2_readiness_guard.py")
        wetting = checked_import("scripts.experiment_v2_wetting_disposition", "/app/scripts/experiment_v2_wetting_disposition.py")
        require(collector.wetting is wetting and guard.wetting is wetting, "collector_guard_wetting_binding_mismatch")
        synthetic_id = "ead8190c-df63-45a7-9570-8e23df0cdb26"
        root = Path("/app/readiness-source")
        collected = wetting.collect(root, application_source=SOURCE, experiment_id=synthetic_id)
        missing = wetting.blockers(collected, root=root, application_source=SOURCE, experiment_id=synthetic_id, now=datetime.now(UTC))
        expected_missing = {"wetting_incident_778_disposition:missing:" + criterion for criterion in ("firmware_binary_lineage", "safe_fog_admission_and_rails", "physical_equipment_qualification", "counter_scope_and_reset_boundaries")}
        require(len(missing) == 4 and set(missing) == expected_missing, "wetting_exact_four_missing_contract_mismatch")
        require(all(value is None for value in collected["criterion_evidence"].values()), "unexpected_physical_evidence")
        require(collected["application_source_revision"] == SOURCE and collected["experiment_id"] == synthetic_id, "wetting_image_only_identity_mismatch")
        report["synthetic_image_only_experiment_id"] = synthetic_id
        report["wetting_manifest_sha256"] = collected["manifest_sha256"]
        report["wetting_blockers"] = sorted(missing)
        report["physical_credit"] = False
        # Every imported product package/submodule must resolve inside the image.
        for name, module in list(sys.modules.items()):
            if name.split(".")[0] in {"verdify_schemas", "experiment_orchestrator", "scripts"}:
                origin = getattr(module, "__file__", None)
                if origin:
                    require(Path(origin).resolve().is_relative_to(Path("/app")), "checkout_shadow_module:" + name)
                else:
                    for item in getattr(module, "__path__", []):
                        require(Path(item).resolve().is_relative_to(Path("/app")), "checkout_shadow_namespace:" + name)
        require(not any(name == "ingestor" or name.startswith("ingestor.") or name == "tasks" or name.startswith("tasks.") for name in sys.modules), "ingestor_worker_runtime_imported")
        report["module_origins"] = origins
        report["loader_metadata_calls"] = loader_metadata_calls
        report["observed_source_revision"] = os.environ["VERDIFY_GIT_SHA"]
        report["status"] = "IMAGE_PACKAGING_CONTRACT_PASSED"
        report["readiness_qualification"] = False
        os.chdir("/tmp")
except Exception as error:
    report["failed_stage"] = stage
    report["error_type"] = type(error).__name__
    # Do not expose arbitrary exception messages or environment values.
    if isinstance(error, CheckFailure):
        report["reason_code"] = str(error)
    else:
        report["reason_code"] = "image_read_or_import_failed"
finally:
    signal.alarm(0)
    report["finished_at"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    print(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")))
sys.exit(0 if report["status"] == "IMAGE_PACKAGING_CONTRACT_PASSED" else 1)
